editorial: Imagine a genetic experiment gone wrong where the ultimate predator wears the face of a supermodel. You get a visceral blend of eroticism and biological horror that pushes 90s practical effects to their limit. The transformation sequences remain the highlight, shifting from seductive elegance to chitinous nightmare with jarring efficiency. You should dive in if you crave a campy, high-concept creature feature that doesn't take itself too seriously.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of 90s biological horror and practical effects.
